description: Object /toolchains (API.md §11): the toolchains detected in the client's environment. The protocol-10 query tools stays as list's v0 alias; rescan is a command (step 5o part B4).

list.description: The toolchains detected in the client's environment, per module type (the live model is not changed). Loads the workspace when none is loaded.

rescan.description: Detect the toolchains again in the client's environment, every module type afresh, and take them into the model, as the status page's L does in-process; replies once the model took them in. Workspace/1 changed precedes the reply when the model's toolchains changed. It replies only after detection settled or 45 s passed (other model requests queue behind it; a client calls it with a timeout of at least 45 s). A detection that does not finish in time is ok with a warn note (it goes on in the background, and Workspace/1 changed follows when it finishes, if the toolchains changed).

tools.description: Per module type, its toolchains: key (absent for a module whose single tool has none), label and the tool's data.
